trans-unit.note: A word added to the name of a slot or an item stack that is marked invalid.
A word shown before the message of a field that fails validation, for example: invalid: Please fill out this field.
Hidden text that tells assistive technology a button is busy.

trans-unit.source: Moving. Use the arrow keys, Enter to place, Escape to cancel.
trans-unit.note: Read aloud when a window enters move mode, and says how to move and place it.
Says how many times a recipe can be made now.
Says that a recipe cannot be made now.
The count of an item stack out of its capacity, for example 75 of 100.
The count of an item stack.
The durability of an item stack as a percentage, for example durability 40%.
The name of the button that closes a window.
The name of the button that dismisses a toast.
The tooltip of the stepper that lowers the value of a number field. It is not announced.
The tooltip of the stepper that raises the value of a number field. It is not announced.
The name of the button that starts moving a window.
The name of the region that holds toasts.
The quality level of an item stack, a whole number from 1 to 5.
The state word of a meter that is in its critical range.
The state word of a meter that is in its warning range.
Hidden text for the dash of a measurement not there yet.
A measurement is falling.
A measurement is rising.
A measurement is steady.

Says that a connection runs to the second node.
